findings.description: Observed OECD population PS_KM2 vs PS collision corrected in PR #85; include regressions and call sites in formal review.
LUR unit metadata unresolved; 35 WEO country-series have no latest actual annual year. No unwarranted observed/forecast inference.
31 historical 2025 region employment rows in local original came from wrong age dimension. No production rewrite without verified backup, vintage, source quality policy and operator authorization.

Global baseline accepts partial provider coverage whenever any countries analyzable; flag semantics and release policy must be audited to avoid interpreting workflow success as full-source certification.
Unused local variable keys is assigned but never referenced; dead code and maintainability. Remove after verifying no instrumentation depends on it.
findings.test_required: test_observation_write_contract.py

findings.description: Validation checks regional geo_code via strip but constructs the persistence identity with code.upper() (not strip()); likewise country_iso3 validated len and alpha but normalized identity assumes upper-case. Confirm actual SQL identity normalization matches the validation key and reject whitespace rather than merging silently.
findings.test_required: negative whitespace and geography case collision fixtures

findings.description: Country-series rows missing last-actual-year are skipped, but the metadata count doesn't retain their exact country/indicator pairs; source audit cannot tell which values were excluded without re-fetching the full workbook.
findings.test_required: missing-actual metadata identities and report fixture

findings.description: sync_countries always returns complete=False and failure_count=1 from the one blocked LUR metric regardless of source coverage, meaning completeness reporting conflates blocked metric scope with missing accepted metric coverage. Report separate blocked metrics and missing requested countries.
findings.test_required: partial source coverage and missing country fixtures

findings.description: datastore_status() is intended as a status probe but uses sqlite3.connect on target path, which creates a new SQLite database when absent; status checks must not mutate operator state. Broad except Exception handlers also suppress actionable permission/schema failures.
findings.test_required: missing SQLite path status probe leaves filesystem untouched, reports reason

findings.description: PersonalProfile persistence handles age, citizenships, household size, income, savings and preferences, while current operator states AUGUR has no personal data. Clarify intended application scope and prevent unintended upload, telemetry, CI fixtures or disclosure; do not delete without call-site audit.
findings.test_required: call graph and data-flow review of profile endpoints/storage/UI with privacy tests

findings.description: initialize_datastores unconditionally invokes seed_esco_partial when mode none. CLI source-smokes rely on initialization; assess unexpected seeding/workload and separate schema bootstrap from optional data seeding.
findings.test_required: bootstrap idempotence and no-side-effect health probe integration

findings.description: Sparse JSON-stat values mapping may not be a dict; .get is used without type/flat-index enforcement and negative or malformed keys can create false observed-region coverage.
findings.test_required: Add sparse shape/negative index adversarial fixtures

findings.description: GISCO extraction accepts duplicate geographic feature codes and does not enforce unique identifiers; this can distort registry trust and duplicate diagnostics.
findings.test_required: Duplicate-feature fail-closed test

findings.description: EEA inspection caps source results to 2000 and marks aggregation ready based only on sampled latest records and coordinate completeness; a partial page can masquerade as full station coverage.
findings.test_required: ArcGIS exceededTransferLimit and paging/total-count negative test

findings.description: Statistics values converted to float without finite-number or unit-consistency validation; NaN and inconsistent years/units risk false summary min/max.
findings.test_required: Reject non-finite/statistical unit conflicts

findings.description: Workbook download checks file extension or content-type but not XLSX PK/ZIP signature, and writes bytes to target without atomic staging.
findings.test_required: Malformed HTML disguised as XLSX + atomic file verification

findings.description: Sector adapter trusts JSON-stat dimension cardinality and values; converts booleans/nonfinite to float and does not verify returned freq/unit/age/sex are the requested dimensions.
findings.test_required: Returned extra/wrong dimension and NaN/boolean regression

findings.description: Fetch builds URL via string replacement without asserting the target fragment exists; if contract URL changes, silently requests unfiltered dataset.
findings.test_required: URL contract assertion fixture

findings.description: Duplicate identity key excludes geography_system/level and performs case-sensitive string comparison before downstream normalization; ensure constraints exactly match writer keys.
findings.test_required: Mixed-case regional duplicate identity test

findings.description: GDP/hour adapter normalizes CSV by TIME_PERIOD and OBS_VALUE alone; does not check REF_AREA, FREQ, MEASURE, ACTIVITY, UNIT_MEASURE, PRICE_BASE or TRANSFORMATION, despite labeling every value as GDPHRS USD PPP/hour.
findings.test_required: Wrong OECD country/measure/unit fixture should fail before upsert
findings.followup: Official OECD live-source smoke remains required to accept observed transport values across supported countries.

findings.description: Inspector can mark ready_for_parser_design true when only one of three heterogeneous source datasets is available; ensure UI or downstream consumers never infer all access/safety measures are ready.
findings.test_required: Partial source report consumer semantics tests

findings.description: Inspector progressively relaxes requested dimension filters yet readiness is based on geographic and ISCO codes rather than exact returned statistical tuple/valid numeric observations. It is exploratory only.
findings.test_required: Return wrong indicator/time/source dimensions; readiness must remain false

findings.description: GISCO city catalogue lacks unique city_code check and scans arbitrary property values for city identifiers, permitting duplicate code rows that turn correct unique city matches into ambiguous results.
findings.test_required: Duplicate official features and conflicting code/name negative fixtures

findings.description: Health indicators use shared labour normalizer but unlike employment/housing lack a pre-fetch canonical metadata-contract check. Examine whether dataset dimensions match application descriptors; do not silently promote exploratory data.
findings.test_required: Health dataset source/filter/unit against canonical catalogue

findings.description: Housing inspector duplicates source configuration separate from canonical fetch contracts; repeated country code and dimension summarizers are consolidation candidates, but deletion requires test/call-site check.
findings.test_required: Inspector vs canonical contract consistency regression

findings.description: Shared regional normalizer iterates full JSON-stat Cartesian dimension product even when values are sparse and filters are exact, potentially high CPU/memory on broad provider datasets; benchmark before optimization.
findings.test_required: Sparse provider payload 1M Cartesian bins performance and output parity

findings.description: Legacy IMF DataMapper adapter remains with April 2026 dataset and one fixed forecast cutoff applied to every country/series, unlike accepted October WEO parser. Determine remaining consumers and mark legacy path explicitly unsafe for source-current global release.
findings.test_required: Legacy call path regression and deprecation transition

findings.description: Single-country and bulk-country WPP normalizers duplicate large projection/value parsing blocks, with maintenance drift risk; projection starts from global 2024 boundary which requires explicit edition-specific documentation.
findings.test_required: Prove row/metadata equality for single and bulk paths plus forecast vintage

findings.description: Annex download considers PDF content-type alone sufficient even when bytes lack PDF magic, and writes unvalidated bytes directly to target rather than staging and atomic replacement.
findings.test_required: Wrong-content-type body and existing-target preservation tests

findings.description: API inspector's ready_for_endpoint_design checks HTTP success and interesting Swagger routes but not whether summary payload contains valid PM2.5 data; avoid interpreting endpoint availability as statistical coverage.
findings.test_required: Empty/partial EEA summary should not certify data coverage

findings.description: Raw provider Parquet URL list accepts arbitrary http hosts and downloads all unbounded files; station coverage rule counts measurement records without proving unique valid hourly/day timestamps. Risk source authenticity, resource exhaustion and coverage inflation.
findings.test_required: Trusted EEA URLs, timestamp uniqueness, non-finite data and resource-limit tests

findings.description: EEA health burden parser permits float('nan')/infinite source values and arbitrary source unit strings while reporting a normalized burden row; missing finite and metric/unit validation.
findings.test_required: Malformed CSV numeric and noncomparable unit regression

findings.description: detect_schema reports ready when occupation_code and score exist, but parse_csv unconditionally accesses matches['occupation_label']; a schema declared ready can raise KeyError.
findings.test_required: Missing occupation label must be rejected in schema readiness tests

findings.description: Shapefile geometry source identifies code by scanning all arbitrary string fields and first registry match; ambiguous multiple official-looking codes and repeated shapes require explicit dimension identity and duplicate policy.
findings.test_required: Ambiguous code-property and duplicate-shape negative fixtures

findings.description: STAS wide worksheet importer must validate that growth percentage units are fractional before multiplying by 100; current code accepts any finite value and scale is assumed from sheet naming. Needs source workbook dimensional/unit evidence.
findings.test_required: Official percentage source-value unit fixture

findings.description: CLSSI workbook parser validates three target countries but not the full expected occupation coverage by country, so unexpectedly truncated worksheets can look statistically complete despite some rows.
findings.test_required: Expected ISCO-2 coverage source manifest fixture

findings.description: STAS raw XLSX parser uses ZipFile and reads XML tree into memory for entire worksheets. Benchmark on official release and establish archive decompression/row limits before accepting untrusted uploads.
findings.test_required: Large sparse worksheet and oversized archive negative tests

findings.description: World Bank country catalog assumes a single response per_page 400, without checking provider pagination metadata; future country count increase or rate-limited partial page can suppress countries.
findings.test_required: Country catalog multi-page/truncated response fixture

findings.description: World Bank single-country normalize labels observations using caller country and indicator without validating provider-returned country code and source indicator for each record; cross-country row leakage is possible if response is wrong.
findings.test_required: Provider mismatched country and indicator negative fixture

findings.description: Country metadata _optional_float() permits nonfinite coordinates, potentially confusing frontend/map consumers.
findings.test_required: NaN country coordinates and out-of-range latitude fixture

findings.description: The general Eurostat normalize() checks dimension_values and label_contains but does not verify config.filters values against returned labels before assigning indicators and units. A provider returning multiple or unexpected populations/units could be mislabeled.
findings.test_required: Returned wrong unit/sex/age/freq and multiple-dimension fixture

findings.description: Specialized earnings/net earnings/job vacancies/job transition normalizers reuse Cartesian JSON-stat expansion but omit the strict cardinality and nonfinite checks present in normalize(). Bool, NaN or infinity can flow to persistent numeric facts.
findings.test_required: Adversarial specialized-numeric and dimension cardinality tests

findings.description: Numerous specialized Eurostat normalizers iterate full Cartesian dimensions even when source JSON-stat values are sparse; expensive broad provider responses may incur unnecessary CPU/memory. Replace after measured parity benchmark.
findings.test_required: Sparse million-cell canonical parity benchmark

findings.description: General Eurostat normalization labels every returned valid numeric datum as observed without dataset-specific source quality policy; provider status flags are persisted but must remain visible to rankings and forecast/revision rules.
findings.test_required: Source flags d/u versus numeric ranking release tests

findings.description: Database bootstrap backfill REPLACEs geography_registry records with NULL for parent_geo_id and lat/long on subsequent startup; may erase enriched geographies.
findings.test_required: Existing seeded geo enrichment persists across repeated initialize_analytics_schema calls

findings.description: Historical migration infers NUTS_2024 from NUTS2/3 level without source-vintage proof, contrary to explicit unverified NUTS ranking gates.
findings.test_required: Legacy NUTS2 rows migrate as NUTS_UNSPECIFIED unless official per-source vintage proof

findings.description: upsert_geographies and upsert_geography_geometries execute batch writes without explicit BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, unlike observation writes.
findings.test_required: Injected failure in second row leaves no partial registry/geometry writes

findings.description: Latest labour occupation outlook returns rows from multiple release_versions for same period rather than selecting one current vintage.
findings.test_required: Two STAS release versions with same period should yield explicit unique release selection

findings.description: Regional sector/health availability queries use exact upper-case geo_level='NUTS2' although geography rows may store lowercase 'nuts2'; risk hidden stored evidence.
findings.test_required: Mixed-case geo_level rows must appear consistently in regional API status and bundles

findings.description: When geography_system omitted subnational query partitions by indicator only; multiple systems sharing geo_code could be mixed in regional and city evidence, including unverified vintage.
findings.test_required: Same-code two-systems fixture retains system-separated evidence or explicit ambiguity

findings.description: Country observation and indicators choose source by priority and observed flag without source_observation_status quality acceptance (d/u); do not treat these API values as ranking-certified.
findings.test_required: Eurostat flagged numeric series remains blocked in ranking API despite being readable as evidence

findings.description: FUA code suffix city/FUA can conflict with published TERRITORIAL_LEVEL and parser currently trusts declared value; source hierarchy and geography identities not independently verified.
findings.test_required: Contradictory suffix/declared level fixture must reject or explicitly remain unverified

findings.description: Seven FUA normalizers repeat float parsing and per-row linear country lookups; source UNIT_MULT scaling and nonfinite/negative source semantics are not independently normalized.
findings.test_required: Source multiplier, NaN, and large country batch benchmark

findings.description: Unrestricted _coverage_fields sets expected countries equal observed countries and marks complete with any rows, not complete source coverage.
findings.test_required: Unknown requested universe should be marked coverage_not_certified rather than complete

findings.description: Regional density normalizer filters UNIT_MEASURE PS_KM2 but not explicit MEASURE; extra measure with identical unit might be misidentified as population density.
findings.test_required: Wrong measure density source tuple rejection

findings.description: Nine regional fetch functions duplicate retry, schema and URL boilerplate; maintenance hotspot, not itself a correctness regression.
findings.test_required: Shared transport refactor preserves URLs and retries by provider fixture

findings.description: Multiple regional normalize methods coerce floats including nonfinite before write; fail-closed write-contract likely guards persistence, but source contract and diagnostics need direct fixtures.
findings.test_required: Provider NaN/infinity rejected for all source series before any writes

findings.description: _coverage_fields with no explicit country allowlist equates observed/requested universe and claims complete, unlike proven source coverage.
findings.test_required: Unknown country scope should not claim complete source coverage

findings.description: Country provider registry still uses legacy April 2026 IMFAdapter DataMapper by default, although globally accepted WEO October 2026 opt-in path exists. Country-specific sync may return HTTP 403 or hardcoded forecast boundary.
findings.test_required: Provider registry migration/country endpoint integration fixture

findings.description: RankingCandidate lacks source_observation_status and response dimensions; check_eligibility may report eligible from boundary_verified=True even with d/u provider status unless separately guarded in caller.
findings.test_required: Flagged quality metadata candidate must not be rankable without status-specific policy

findings.description: coverage_matrix performs nested scans for every geography/contract, O(G*C*O), not indexed; large global expansion risks heavy latency.
findings.test_required: Indexed reference parity benchmark and 1000+ geographies

findings.description: Accessing Settings.data_dir creates filesystem directory even during a purported read-only probe; dependency and CLI call sites must avoid implying zero side effects.
findings.test_required: Read-only command with absent data root must create no directory

findings.description: unregistered_observations query returns global rows even when country filter is supplied; report labels global scope but callers might misinterpret as country-specific.
findings.test_required: API contract requires explicit global unregistered_scope and separate count

findings.description: Every FastAPI startup initializes/updates both datastores, so merely starting the API is not read-only. Audited bootstrap may seed catalogs and migrate geography schema on service launch.
findings.test_required: Startup dry-run/status cannot mutate source DB before authorization

findings.description: Source status d/u are blocked conservatively but no edition-specific official Eurostat quality-flag policy accepted; rankings remain correctly blocked.
findings.test_required: Official flag acceptance matrix provider evidence

findings.description: Ranking service accepts caller-supplied verified_geo_ids as proof of historical boundary vintage, with no internally authenticated official reference binding; users/API callers could incorrectly enable numeric ranking if verification IDs trusted externally.
findings.test_required: Verified-geography IDs must be sourced from signed/proven registry not request-controlled

findings.description: Bool and non-finite numeric values pass current isinstance(int,float) and range comparisons in some cases; malformed upstream provider metrics may appear available.
findings.test_required: NaN/bool housing ratio guard

findings.description: Global in-process EEA/GISCO cache is shared for all callers, including injected clients and force-refresh, without provider-version key. Fresh source mapping may be stale for 24h and ambiguous codes omitted.
findings.test_required: Cache provenance, ambiguity and invalidation tests

findings.description: Comparison groups same indicator across countries using the first observed unit, without verifying subsequent source units, periods or comparative semantics, while labeling aligned current observations.
findings.test_required: Mixed unit/dataset country fixture should flag incomparable rather than group silently

findings.description: Use horizons or DEFAULT_HORIZONS silently replaces user-supplied empty horizons list with defaults; validate explicit intent.
findings.test_required: Explicit empty list should yield empty horizons

findings.description: country_metadata overlays saved DB country info with catalog nonempty values even when more recent authoritative country metadata was persisted; potential stale information.
findings.test_required: Catalog versus persisted source precedence audit
